text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne. I’m a full stack developer with 7 years of experience working across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I’m interested in your WordPress performance role because speed issues usually come from a mix of inefficient code, slow database queries, and a few architectural decisions that compound over time. I’m comfortable getting into the details, tracing bottlenecks, and making practical improvements where they’ll have the most impact.

A relevant example of the kind of performance-focused work I do was the Home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home. I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves. One result was improving largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s.

Another project was the Booking platform for fitness studios for Pulsebox Studios. I built a white-label class booking app where each studio gets its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships. That project reached 64 studios onboarded in 6 months, with 71% checkout conversion.

For your site, I would start by identifying the slow pages and isolating the cause of the slowdown: bad PHP code paths, inefficient MySQL queries, unnecessary work during page generation, or other bottlenecks inside WordPress. From there, I’d work through targeted fixes and verify the impact as I go. I’m also comfortable working in a collaborative environment and can adapt to your workflow, including BitBucket and WP Pusher.

I’d be glad to help improve performance and make the site more maintainable long term. If you’d like, I can jump in and start by reviewing the slowest pages and outlining the highest-value fixes first.
